what_happened: The wrapper at evidence/ord0342-two-anchor-cells-b/ord0342_r6_readings_r1.json was written twice: the first pass labelled the pre-fix generation with the candidate's own first commit (which already holds the fix) and computed the ruler's blob id as a bare sha1 of the file, so it reported blob_verified=false for a ruler that does match. The corrected document then went to the SAME path, which is a published coordinate and should never have been re-PUT.
which_to_quote: the now blob; the was document's pre-fix label named a tree that already contains the fix, so any 'before' claim read out of it is void
reading_back: both versions were fetched from the commits API by path+ref and their blob ids recomputed with git's own header rule (sha1 over 'blob <len>' + NUL + bytes)
rule_fitted_after: ord0342_deliver.py push() now refuses a same-name different-bytes publish and demands a new revision file, so the door itself cannot repeat this
